stories.title: Mob attacks Bastar prayer hall after dispute over Christian burial
stories.summary: A disagreement over Christian burial rites in a Kanker village escalated into vandalism at a prayer hall, with police personnel among those reportedly injured. The episode reflects persistent tension around religious practice and burial access in Bastar. The supplied report does not identify any settlement between the communities involved.
stories.why_it_matters: Violence over funeral rights threatens religious freedom and community safety. Impartial investigation, protection for worship and lawful burial arrangements can reduce the risk of retaliation.
stories.evidence_status: The Hindu reports the vandalism and police injuries, but case records and accounts from all communities are unavailable.

confidence.rationale: The central development is supported by the linked The Hindu - States report, while the stated evidence gaps prevent a high-confidence assessment.

coverage.rationale: Only one distinct reporting desk is supplied for this event, so wider coverage and independent corroboration cannot be established.
